prior_narrative.tldr: This page mechanically groups four items that share the phrase "large language models" in their title, not one developing story. It runs from an agent-swarm benchmark through an HVAC deployment review to a Zhipu/MiniMax business-model roundup, with nothing connecting them but that phrase.
prior_narrative.whats_new: The three clinical-comparison and medical-hallucination items previously on this page have aged out of the window; the newest item is still Sep 10's domain-specific hallucination detector combining fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 classification with Monte Carlo sampling.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Ranking-by-shared-title-phrase can silently fold unrelated arxiv papers and business news into one page -- treat this grouping as noise, not corroboration, before citing more than one item from it together.

beats.headline: SwarmBench tests LLMs as orchestrators of dynamically-formed agent swarms
Critical review surveys LLM deployment readiness for HVAC building-energy operations
Weekend roundup contrasts Zhipu and MiniMax as two distinct LLM business models

open_questions: Does SwarmBench report results for today's popular agent frameworks, or only for research prototypes?
Does the DeBERTa-v3 domain-specific hallucination detector generalize across domains, or need per-domain fine-tuning?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Don't treat a shared link on this page as corroboration across sources -- these items are grouped by word overlap only; verify each independently before citing them together.
